name: NZBGet

lifecycle.note: The nzbgetcom fork released v26.3 on 2026-08-27; use its maintained image, not artifacts from the legacy nzbget organization.

security: Keep provider credentials and the control interface on a private network; the RPC control interface uses HTTP Basic authentication unless HTTPS is configured.
Change the documented default control password before exposing the interface to another device.
pitfalls: The archived legacy repository and images can be mistaken for the maintained successor.
The official Docker image documents NZBGET_PASS as a plain environment variable, not a file-backed secret; shared Compose must generate its private environment file before the container starts.
NZBGet RPC uses username/password pairs and does not document an API key.
